purpose: Part 2/2 of verified hard-tail 10-record item effect batch 021; together these files contain exactly 10 reviewed records with complete captured mechanics.

items/tome-of-the-wyrm.name: Tome of the Wyrm
items/tome-of-the-wyrm.effectSummary: While carried in one hand by a spellcaster, the tome grants +1 insight caster level to spells that target or include an enemy dragon. At the end of each turn the bonus rises by 1 if the caster harmed an enemy dragon that turn and falls by 1 otherwise, never below +1 or above the caster's highest spell level; it returns to +1 one hour after the last qualifying harm. The book also automatically records up to 200 dragon battles, overwriting the oldest when full.

items/lucky-charm-332.name: Lucky Charm
items/lucky-charm-332.effectSummary: A new bracelet has seven consumable charms. A wearer who has a source of luck rerolls can, as an immediate action when they would spend one luck reroll, consume one charm instead to gain the benefit of a successful luck reroll without spending the daily reroll; only one charm can be used per round and it cannot pay for effects requiring more than one reroll.

items/map-unseen-lands-438.name: Map of Unseen Lands [Relic]
items/map-unseen-lands-438.effectSummary: For a neutral-good, lawful-good, chaotic-good, or neutral holder, the map grants +5 competence on Knowledge (geography) and Survival. With the relic connection to Yondalla, once per day it can spend 2 minutes redrawing an accurate map of terrain within a 10-mile radius, prioritizing general terrain, major structures, travel-relevant structures, then lairs of CR 12+ creatures; it does not function underground.

items/mirror-of-mental-prowess.name: Mirror of Mental Prowess
items/mirror-of-mental-prowess.effectSummary: The mirror can read the thoughts of a reflected creature while its owner is within 25 feet, scry like a crystal ball including across planes when sufficiently familiar, and create a two-way portal to a scryed location that lasts until the user returns, commands it closed, or 24 hours pass. Once per week it can accurately answer one short question about a creature whose image is shown on its surface.

items/hathran-masks.name: Hathran Masks
items/hathran-masks.effectSummary: Hathran masks occupy the lenses slot and come in multiple forms: Disguise changes only the face as a hat of disguise; Flame provides fire endure-elements protection and burning hands once per day at caster level 5, DC 11; Mental Armor grants +4 resistance against mind-affecting effects; Language grants fluency in three chosen languages; Nightseeing grants 60-foot darkvision; Protection and Resistance combines equal deflection and resistance bonuses from +1 to +5; True Seeing grants true seeing; and Water Breathing grants water breathing.
